description:
The roadmaps were deleted as obsolete status duplicates without a check that their planned items are tracked. This work maps the planned items of the root roadmap's Open Research Questions and Publication & Validation sections so relevant work stays represented in the tracker.

## Background

The deleted files are recoverable from git as `61c3f0a6a^:ROADMAP.md`, `61c3f0a6a^:crates/gf2-core/ROADMAP.md` and `791beb2b0^:crates/gf2-coding/ROADMAP.md`. `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.9 locates their planned sections and counts their items. Epics already covering roadmap themes include GPU production, FPGA, competitive benchmarking, polar codes, neural BP and GNU Radio integration.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A linked mapping record lists each planned, unchecked, open-question or future-direction item of the root roadmap's Open Research Questions and Publication & Validation sections, citing revision and line, with one disposition: tracked by a named issue, delivered by named code, obsolete with a reason, or newly filed.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each item classified as untracked relevant work has a filed backlog issue with standalone success criteria, named in the record.
title: Map the root roadmap's open questions and publication items
